questions.markdown:
A metal plate is to be punched with a hole, the plate can take a maximum shear stress of 150 MPa. The compressive stress in the punch is limited to 200 MPa.

Determine:

i) Maximum thickness of the plate for which a 50 mm diameter hole can be punched

ii) If the plate is 5 mm thick, smallest diameter hole that can be punched.

When a tensile axial load was applied on a round bar of 40mm diameter and 2.5m length, the extension observed was 2.5 mm. Calculate the bulk modulus and lateral contraction of the bar if $E = 170\ \text{GPa}$ & $G = 63\ \text{GPa}$.

A composite bar of a rectangular section consists of a tapered aluminum section rigidly fastened between a bronze section and a steel section, as shown in the figure. The thickness of the section is 10mm throughout the length. Axial loads are applied at the positions indicated.

Determine the stress in the steel and bronze sections. Also, determine the change in total length. Take $E_b = 100\ \text{GPa}$, $E_{Al} = 70\ \text{GPa}$ and $E_s = 200\ \text{GPa}$.

diagrams.caption: Composite bar with tapered aluminum section, steel section, and bronze section; dimensions include 60 mm at the aluminum end, lengths 500 mm, 150 mm, 200 mm, section depths 40 mm and 30 mm, and axial loads 30 kN, 50 kN, 20 kN, and 60 kN. (original source region)
